scientific_configuration.scope: All296 existing development BO3 histories only
scientific_configuration.tie_rule: log loss tolerance1e-12 then lower beta then higher alpha
scientific_configuration.inner_selection_objective: full-field n/100 BO3-averaged deck log loss; equal games and chooser; no outer labels/scores
scientific_configuration.training_count: one final match-scoped reveal lower-bound vector per training BO3; no overlapping-prefix training examples
scientific_configuration.inference_inputs: certified legal copy lower bounds, current hard facts, fixed library/prevalence; no scheduled identity, hidden labels, results, scores, behavioral features or policy actions
scientific_configuration.theta: (training revealed count+alpha*deck copies/60)/(total training revealed count+alpha)
scientific_configuration.log_weights: log(prior)+beta*sum(lower_bound*log(theta)); hard shared allocation compatibility then stable normalization
methods: A: same conditional allocation with compatibility-filtered prevalence, beta0
B: same conditional allocation with inner-selected Bayesian weights
known-deck diagnostic: scorer-only true-deck conditional output; not deployable or an upper bound
feature_schema: unknown-hand mean; total-hand mean adds certified known count
scientific_configuration.variance: within conditional component + between component/deck mean variance
scientific_configuration.remaining_composition: MAE over full library vocabulary of inferred original copies minus certified revealed-copy lower bound versus true remaining copies
